name: Electrical Live Transfers

hero.headline: Electrical Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for electrical solutions.

overview: Electrical Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect homeowners needing electrical repairs, panel upgrades and EV charger installation with licensed electricians in their service area.

Live Transfers help electrical contractors direct their licensed workforce to the right jobs. Our team confirms the service address, homeownership, the nature of the electrical work and its urgency before warm-transferring the call, so safety issues reach dispatch quickly and project inquiries are routed to estimators. Screening filters out renters, out-of-area callers and requests for minor tasks that fall below the contractor's minimum, and it flags high-value opportunities such as panel upgrades, generators and EV installations for priority handling.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of electrical consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners in single-family homes, especially older properties with original wiring or undersized panels, as well as owners adding electric vehicles, generators or major appliances. High-value segments include panel upgrade and EV charger customers, homeowners with code or insurance-driven remediation needs, and those planning renovations that require new circuits.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for electrician near me or emergency electrician; breakers tripping frequently, flickering lights or burning smell near outlets; purchased an electric vehicle and needs a home charger installed; home inspection or insurer flagged outdated wiring or panel.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "electrician near me" and "emergency electrician", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard electrical criteria include: property located within the electrician's licensed service area; homeowner or authorised decision maker for the property; type of electrical work identified as repair, panel upgrade, installation or inspection; urgency level established for safety-related issues; interested in scheduling a service visit or estimate; not seeking diy guidance or parts-only assistance.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: Can we focus on EV charger and panel upgrade work?
faq.a: Yes. Campaigns and screening can emphasise installation and upgrade projects, and repair-only calls can be limited to match your business mix.

faq.q: Do you deliver emergency electrical calls after hours?
faq.a: Delivery schedules follow your availability, so after-hours emergency calls can be included if you offer that service, or held to business hours if you do not.

faq.q: How do you confirm the caller is in our service area?
faq.a: The property address is confirmed during screening and matched against the ZIP codes or radius you define, and out-of-area callers are excluded before transfer.
